user.title: Connect PSE&G Account
user.description: Select how you would like to connect your PSE&G MySmartEnergy account:

automated.title: Automated Sign-In
automated.description: Enter your PSE&G online credentials. If two-factor authentication is requested by Okta, you will be prompted for your one-time verification code on the next step.

mfa.title: Two-Factor Verification
mfa.description: A 6-digit verification code has been sent to your selected phone or email. Enter the code below to complete setup.

cookie.title: Browser Session Cookie
cookie.description:
Authenticate directly using an active session cookie from your web browser.

**How to get your cookie:**
1. In your browser, log in to the PSE&G portal (mysmartenergy.nj.pseg.com)
2. Press **F12** (or right-click → **Inspect**) to open Developer Tools
3. Click the **Network** tab, then refresh the page (F5)
4. Click any request to mysmartenergy.nj.pseg.com (e.g. `Dashboard`)
5. In **Request Headers**, copy the full value of the `Cookie:` header and paste it below.
